Hi Sam,

Thanks for getting in touch.

Ledgerly sends two reminders for each invoice: 3 days before the due date and
on the day it is due. You can change both in **Settings > Reminders**, or turn
reminders off for one customer from their page.

If a customer says they never received a reminder, check the email address on
their page first. Reply here if it looks right and we'll look into it.

Kind regards,
Ledgerly support
